items.title: "명품 살 돈이 없어요"...중산층 발길 끊기자 루이비통·구찌에 닥친 위기
items.summary: Reports Gucci and Louis Vuitton both face a middle-class pullback; Gucci cut the Padlock Crystal Small Top Handle Bag from EUR3,500 to EUR2,450 (-30%) and now lists 16 handbags under $2,000 on its US site after 13 consecutive quarters of sales decline, while LVMH's CFO says it will not pursue price segmentation despite LV's own 8% Q3 sales drop.

items.title: "명품보다 가성비" 중국 Z세대, 구찌 대신 코치 구매
items.summary: Bloomberg-sourced piece on Chinese Gen Z trading down from Gucci/Balenciaga to Coach and Muji; quotes a former big-spending Shanghai consumer calling logo luxury 'outdated,' while Coach and Ralph Lauren China sales rose over 30% in Q3 even as LVMH and Kering posted double-digit China declines.

items.title: 구찌의 몰락, 수백억 달러 브랜드의 정체성 상실
items.summary: Long-form critical analysis arguing Gucci lost its creative identity after Alessandro Michele's 2022 exit, cycling through four CEOs and multiple designers in two years, and that Demna's debut drew only muted attention; frames the brand as stuck in an unclear middle ground between logo loyalists and minimalist converts. Included despite being outside the 14-day freshness window because its 'identity loss' framing is still being echoed in this week's fresh price-cut and China-demand coverage (NEA-001/002); treat as background context, not a fresh signal.

items.title: Gucci Cruise 2028 in Shanghai: show on May 17, 2027 with Demna
items.summary: Confirms Gucci will stage its Cruise 2028 show in Shanghai on 17 May 2027 under Demna, marking 30 years since the brand's first China store, building on a history of Shanghai-based cultural projects (Gucci Cosmos, Gucci Bamboo).

items.title: [럭셔리월드] 콧대 높던 명품도 무릎 꿇나...가격 내리는 구찌 vs 버티는 루이비통
items.summary: Business feature contrasting Gucci's decisive price cuts with Louis Vuitton's refusal to follow, framing it as the luxury sector's broader dilemma of eroding pricing power amid a prolonged middle-class pullback.

items.title: 구찌는 30% 내렸는데, 망설이는 루이비통...'가격' 딜레마에 빠진 명품업계
items.summary: Covers the industry-wide pricing dilemma Gucci's cuts have triggered; Louis Vuitton hesitates to match despite its own sales softness, as analysts debate whether price cuts will restore volume or simply confirm declining brand power.

items.title: 박보검 '구찌 왕자' 됐다...새 글로벌 행보
items.summary: Reports Park Bo-gum's appointment as Gucci global brand ambassador, noting he previously served as Celine's first Korean male global ambassador, and will now front Gucci campaigns and events.

items.title: 古驰国内和国外价差有多少？2026年实测最高省10900元
items.summary: Weibo consumer-guide post measuring the price gap between Gucci's domestic China pricing and overseas pricing, finding buyers can save up to 10,900 yuan purchasing abroad; reflects ongoing price-sensitivity scrutiny among Chinese shoppers.

items.title: 古驰在奢侈品行业处于什么地位？152亿美元品牌价值却营收承压
items.summary: Weibo explainer questioning Gucci's current standing in the luxury hierarchy, noting a brand valuation still near $15.2 billion even as revenue remains under sustained pressure; framed as buying-advice/analysis content rather than brand marketing.

items.title: 古驰最近有什么大新闻？Demna首秀爆款、降价40%、关店105家值得抄底吗？
items.summary: Weibo FAQ-style explainer synthesizing three Gucci storylines for prospective buyers: Demna's debut collection breakout pieces, price cuts of up to 40% in some markets, and 105 net store closures, asking whether now is a good time to buy.

items.title: 90만원 구찌 가방에 각기 다른 품질보증서 2개...오픈마켓 가품 판매 성행
items.summary: Consumer-watchdog report on counterfeit and inconsistent-documentation Gucci bags sold through open marketplaces, citing a buyer who received a 900,000-won bag with two different warranty cards listing different model names; raises authentication and open-market distribution-control concerns.

items.title: 구찌, 새 스니커즈에 '메이드 인 중국' 붙여 판매 시작

Older than the 14-day window; retained only as corroborating context, not scored as a fresh signal.
